docs: Shared TypeScript settings for every workspace (.ai/architecture.md).
Packages extend this and declare only what actually differs: their own
`types` (Workers vs. Bun), any extra `lib`, and `include`. Keeping the
common set here means a compiler-option change is one edit rather than
six, and no workspace can quietly drift to weaker settings.
apps/web deliberately does NOT extend this: it extends the config
SvelteKit generates into .svelte-kit/, which owns paths and rootDirs.
Changing that file's compilerOptions is how you break `$lib` imports.
